summary: Lipocine Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 11, 2026, disclosing a September 8, 2026 amendment to its April 26, 2024 sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The agent's fee on future at-the-market sales will be up to 3.0%, subject to adjustment by the parties. No securities were issued or sold in this filing, which merely alters placement-agent economics. The company remains an at-the-market issuer under an existing shelf. Watch for periodic prospectus supplements and 424B5 filings as sales occur, plus dilution pace and any price-related overhang.
